## Personality

Bertha Shirley possessed a skill for writing expressive, charming letters. Her written words and thoughts successfully captured her personality, retaining their beauty over time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## History

Bertha Shirley was deeply in love with her husband when they married. Years later, her daughter [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited her birthplace and received a bundle of old love letters written by Bertha and her husband. Reading these letters allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to feel truly connected to her parents for the first time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P19](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0019), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_
